description: This file contains tests for the 'minimax provider catalog' using the Vitest testing framework. It verifies that certain models are correctly advertised or filtered, and that pricing for specific models remains distinct. It references an external helper function for resolving implicit providers and interacts with file system modules to create temporary directories and write JSON configuration files.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for minimax provider catalog.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Assertion function used for testing expectations.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases within the test suite.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes data to a file asynchronously.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins path segments into a single path.

methods.name: resolveImplicitProvidersForTest
methods.description: External helper function imported from another module to resolve implicit provider configurations.
